The pre-gate preparation line ('Apply admin only to ABC-102, nightly only to ABC-101') is a scope statement, not a draft disclosure, so first-gate still holds, but moving that sentence into the per-ticket gates would remove any argument that a later ticket is surfaced before the first reply.
